channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — City Council Decisions (Green & Climate)
channel.description: Utrecht city council decisions and documents explained in plain language.

item.title: Adoption of Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026
item.description: The Gemeenteraad has adopted the Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026. The decision includes programming investments in affordable housing, sustainable mobility, green spaces, and allocating preparation credits for redevelopments.

item.title: Exemption of residence requirement
item.description: The city council discusses a proposal to exempt the residence requirement for aldermen.

item.title: Amendment to Participatiewet re-integration ordinance
item.description: The Gemeenteraad is updating the Verordening re-integratie en tegenprestatie Participatiewet. This provides young people up to 27 with better support from school to work and introduces a new Ontwikkeltraject.

item.title: Environmental plan Jan van Galenstraat-Huizingalaan-Van Ginnekenlaan
item.description: The Gemeenteraad is deciding on the TAM environmental plan for Jan van Galenstraat, Huizingalaan, and Van Ginnekenlaan. This enables the construction of 102 rental homes, a supermarket, retail units, and an underground parking garage.

item.title: Environmental plan update Pijlsweerd, Lauwerecht, Vogelenbuurt, Tuinwijk
item.description: The council is adopting the second amendment to the Utrecht environmental plan. This converts ten zoning plans in Noordwest and Noordoost into the definitive environmental plan and adds rules on soil quality and archaeology.

item.title: Declaration of no objection expansion Theo Pouw Isotopenweg
item.description: The college proposes that the council issue a specific declaration of no objection for Theo Pouw at Isotopenweg 29. This enables the Province of Utrecht to grant a permit for two new waste processing activities.
